title: Split preparation scan configuration
statement: For $k\in\mathbb N$, Boolean strings $w,s$, and $j\in\mathbb N$, let $p(w,j)$ denote the input-head position assigned to $w$ and $j$ by the split-position construction, let $B_s$ be the buffer tape formed from $s$, and let $P_j$ be the catalog polynomial tape associated with $j$. The split-preparation machine with $k+1$ work tapes has a configuration on input $w$ whose state is $(0,\mathbf 1_{|w|>j\,\text{or}\,|w|<j})=(0,\mathbf 1_{|w|<j})$, whose input-head position is $p(w,j)$, whose first work tape is $B_s$ and whose remaining work tapes are each $P_j$, with every work-tape head at position $j$ and empty output.
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the split-position, buffer-tape, or catalog-polynomial-tape constructions, so their contents cannot be made self-contained from the provided material.
